'''Thrash of the Titans!''' (Japanese: '''ドラゴンバトル！サトシVSアイリス！！''' ''Dragon Battle! {{tt|Satoshi|Ash}} VS Iris!!'') is the nineteenth chapter of the {{ma|Pokémon Journeys}} manga. It is based on the [[JN065|animated series episode by the same name]].

==Plot==
{{Incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* {{Ash}} reunites with {{an|Iris}} and defeats her in a [[World Coronation Series]] match, advancing him to the Ultra Class.
* Ash is revealed to have {{pkmn2|caught}} a {{AP|Dracovish}}.
* [[Ash's Dragonite]] learns {{m|Draco Meteor}}.

===Debuts===
====Pokémon debuts====
* {{p|Dracovish}} 
* {{p|Haxorus}} 
* {{p|Pansage}} 
* {{p|Axew}}

* {{Ash}}
* {{an|Iris}}

* [[Drayden]]

===Pokémon===
* {{p|Pikachu}} ({{OP|Ash|Pikachu}})

* {{p|Haxorus}} ({{OP|Iris|Haxorus}})
* {{p|Dragonite}} ({{OP|Ash|Dragonite}})
* {{p|Dracovish}} ({{OP|Ash|Dracovish}})
* {{p|Dragonite}} ({{OP|Iris|Dragonite}})
* {{p|Pansage}} ({{OP|Cilan|Pansage}}; flashback)
* {{p|Grookey}} ({{OP|Goh|Grookey}})

* {{p|Rotom}} ([[Drone Rotom]])

==Differences between the animated series and the manga==
* [[Goh]] {{pkmn2|caught|catching}} {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Pansear}} and {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Panpour}} is omitted. As such, he first encounters {{an|Iris}} at the [[Opelucid Gym]].
* As the events of ''[[JN050|A Pinch of This, a Pinch of That!]]'' were omitted, [[Ash's Dracovish]] debuts here.

==Errors==
* In the English print, [[Ash's Dracovish]] is misspelled as Dra'''g'''ovish.
